title: The New Age SMP Pack
description: This project adds several tech-related mods along with superb warfare as its main mod.
body:
In general, this modpack adds a lot of modern weapons and tech, especially for fighting off the Spore hordes and other players.

**Superb Warfare** will add several militray vehicles and weapons to your experience, allowing you to show extreme firepower against your enemies, human or not.

**Mekanism** will add several power-generation options, along with many ways to multiply ores. This will be very useful for when you require power for vehicles, and ores for all sorts of weapons.

**Sophisticated Backpacks** will make storage abroad much easier, allowing for exploration and looting that normally wouldn't be possible.

**Fungal Infection: Spore** adds a brand new threat to replace the vanilla mobs seen around the overworld. Make sure that you put a bullet in their skulls. Or a 20mm, that also works.

These mods should enhance gameplay and will hopefully be fun for the New Age SMP.
